contract:
FOLD THIS SIGNAL (plain text, no em-dashes, under 150 words): the row below is a signal an estate captured. Answer three things only: (1) TRUE-TODAY: is this signal still true given everything else you know in the row's context - yes/no/unknown with one line of why; (2) THE ORGAN: which kind of organ should own this signal (a law, a clock, a gate, a memory row, or compost); (3) THE FALSIFIER: the observation that would prove the signal wrong. Mark unknowns UNKNOWN; do not pad.

SIGNAL: STRUCTURED TASK ENVELOPE CONTEXT: Game world "Ledger of Empty Chairs" — a shared, append-only ledger where players post transactions. Each transaction contains a fixed 256-byte `noise_field` (ostensibly a random seed for game RNG). We need a covert channel: outsiders must see only random noise (deniability), while the intended recipient can recover the message and cryptographically prove authorship (verifiability). No asymmetric keys — only a shared symmetric codebook. ROLE: Cryptographic protocol designer for the game world. TASK: Design a concrete, buildable protocol for deniable-yet-verifia
